verified: Unit-domain box attenuates cos(2pi ky*y+2pi kx*x) by sinc(ky*height)*sinc(kx*width); height then width ordering matches row/column coordinates.
Native model coord=2q-1 and cell=2widths correctly converts unit-domain box full widths to model [-1,1] coordinates.
Isolated lte.py passes rel_cell into learned phase without max/clamp; coord clamp only affects local ensemble grid fetch. SC applies sinc(omega*rel_cell/2), consistent with its Fourier units.
Quadrature evaluates FINAL RGB zero-cell conditional field at 2D midpoint nodes; not merely internal feature integral. Encoder cached once for every case/model.

Synthetic gain=(MSEpoint-MSEnative)/S equals -change_energy-alignment with error=point-truth. Natural Ep=truth-point changes alignment sign, giving gain=-energy+alignment; both residual formulas are correct.
Calibration phase_index0 and held-out phase_index1 do not mix arrays in affine/median fits. Grid fixed before inference; all phases still share one synthetic family.

interpretation_boundaries: Synthetic zero-cell/anisotropic footprints/content are outside natural training support, so failures do not show ordinary task performance loss or all-model impossibility.
Zero-cell conditional field is mathematically computed, but has not been proven equal to true physical point radiance.
Known-law forecast uses true frequency/amplitude/target in scoring; even strong result is oracle law diagnostic, not observed-y deployment selector.
phase pi/2 is phase-held-out on identical frequencies/directions/mean/amplitude; rows/footprints/phases are correlated, not independent generalization trials.
Simple band index is a coarse reference; within-band directional/shape tests provide incremental diagnostics but classical area integration identity is not itself new.
Squared-error energy/alignment decomposition is exact posthoc arithmetic requiring target and thus explains sign algebraically, not a predictive causal mechanism.
Barbara is a known retrospective negative case; comparing same-weight zero-cell intervention vs separately retrained ablation tests different questions.
Two quadrature orders are a convergence diagnostic, not a mathematical error bound; accidental agreement cannot certify exact integrals.
